info.title: Microsoft.EdgeOperator - Azure Local Disconnected Operations log collection
info.description: Microsoft.EdgeOperator management API for Azure Local Disconnected Operations log collection.

post.description: Starts collecting logs for the specified time range. Returns 202 Accepted with no response body.

Azure-AsyncOperation.description: A link to the status monitor

Location.description: The Location header contains the URL where the status of the long running operation can be checked.

Retry-After.description: The Retry-After header can indicate how long the client should wait before polling the operation status.

204.description: There is no content to send for this request, but the headers may be useful.

post.description: Starts collecting logs to the specified destination path. Returns 202 Accepted with no response body.

Azure-AsyncOperation.description: A link to the status monitor

Location.description: The Location header contains the URL where the status of the long running operation can be checked.

Retry-After.description: The Retry-After header can indicate how long the client should wait before polling the operation status.

204.description: There is no content to send for this request, but the headers may be useful.

get.description: Lists log collection job history from the specified date and time.
Gets the status and available history details of a log collection job by its GUID identifier.

CollectLogsIndirectRequest.description: The time range, destination, and optional credentials for indirect log collection.

fromDate.description: The start of the log collection time range, in UTC.

toDate.description: The end of the log collection time range, in UTC. Must be later than fromDate.

saveToPath.description:
The absolute UNC path to the destination file share where the collected logs
are saved, for example `\\fileserver\share\logs`.
The destination must be accessible to the log-collection backend.

userName.description: The user name used to access the destination path, when authentication is required.

userPassword.description: The password used to access the destination path, when authentication is required.

filterRoles.description: The roles to collect logs from. Omit to use the service's default role selection.

CollectLogsRequest.description: The time range and optional role filter for collecting logs.

fromDate.description: The start of the log collection time range, in UTC.

toDate.description: The end of the log collection time range, in UTC. Must be later than fromDate.

filterRoles.description: The roles to collect logs from. Omit to use the service's default role selection.

LogCollection.description:
A read-only log collection job created by collectLogs or collectLogsIndirect.
The request subscription must be the Operator subscription; requests for other subscriptions are rejected.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

LogCollectionErrorDetails.description: Error details reported by the log collection service.

code.description: The service-defined error code. Omitted when no code is available.

message.description: The error message. Omitted when no message is available.

LogCollectionJobType.description: The type of a log collection job.

values.name: OnDemand
values.description: The job was started on demand by a collectLogs or collectLogsIndirect request.

values.name: Scheduled
values.description: The job was started by the log collection service on a schedule.

LogCollectionListResult.description: A page of log collection job history. The service currently returns all matching jobs in a single page.

value.description: The log collection jobs in the requested history window.

nextLink.description: The URL of the next page of jobs. Omitted when all matching jobs have been returned.

LogCollectionProperties.description: The status and available history details of a log collection job.

provisioningState.description: The provisioning state derived from the log collection service's job state.

startTime.description: The job start time in UTC, when available.

endTime.description: The job completion time in UTC, when available.

collectionTime.description: The collection start time in UTC, when available in job history.

collectionEndTime.description: The collection completion time in UTC, when available in job history.

fromDate.description: The requested start of the log time range in UTC, when available in job history.

toDate.description: The requested end of the log time range in UTC, when available in job history.

jobType.description: The job type, when available in job history.

storageKind.description: Where the collected logs are delivered, when available in job history.

saveToPath.description:
The absolute UNC path to the destination file share where the collected logs
are saved, for example `\\fileserver\share\logs`.
Present only when storageKind is FileShare.

reason.description: A free-text description of why the job ran, when available in job history.

error.description: The error details associated with the job. Omitted when the service reports no error.

uploadDetails.description: The upload details associated with the job. Omitted when the service reports no upload details.

LogCollectionProvisioningState.description: The provisioning state of a log collection job.

LogCollectionStorageKind.description: Where the collected logs are delivered.

values.name: Azure
values.description: The collected logs are sent to Azure. Used by jobs started with collectLogs.

values.name: FileShare
values.description: The collected logs are saved to a file share. Used by jobs started with collectLogsIndirect; the share is reported in saveToPath.

LogCollectionUploadDetails.description: Upload details reported by the log collection service.

uploadStartTime.description: The upload start time in UTC. Omitted when unavailable.

uploadSizeInMb.description: The size in megabytes of the collected logs, as reported by the log collection service.

uploadNumberOfFiles.description: The number of collected log files, as reported by the log collection service.

uploadDirectory.description: The directory containing the uploaded logs. Omitted when unavailable.

LogCollectionHistoryParameters.name: fromDate
LogCollectionHistoryParameters.description:
The earliest date and time in UTC for which job history is requested.
The downstream log collection service requires a history start time and supports no other filter criteria,
so this is a typed parameter rather than an OData $filter expression.
